Gift.title: Friendship Gift
Gift.description: A personalized, live-updatable storybook friendship card tied to a unique shareable gift ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator who owns and can update this gift.

openingLetter.description: Opening card message inside the envelope.

scrapbookIntroKicker.description: Small handwritten kicker above the first scrapbook spread.

scrapbookIntroHeading.description: Heading above the first scrapbook spread.

secondNote.description: Conversational side note beside the first Polaroid spread.

collageHeading.description: Heading above the overlapping photo constellation.

hiddenFlowerNote.description: Short hidden message revealed when tapping the flower doodle.

hiddenEnvelopeNote.description: Short P.S. message revealed when tapping the hidden mini-envelope.

endingText.description: Newline-separated closing lines for the ending card.

photos.description: Fixed 6-slot list of Polaroid memory objects (id, src, caption, dateNote, memoryNote).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the unique gift link was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the gift was last updated.

/gifts/{giftId}.description: Stores each unique, live-updatable friendship gift document. Readable by single-doc get with the unique giftId; writable only by its verified ownerId.
